name: R1 Single-Unit Residential
source: SMMC 9.07.030 Table (as amended Oct 2019); City Housing Element 2021-2029 Appendix E Figure E-2; City press release 2019-10-23
verified: 2026-09-23 from the City Housing Element table and press release; the current Table 9.07.030 text (ecode360) could not be fetched; confirm side setback aggregate rule and stepbacks before relying on it
notes: Front setback: varies by street (Official Districting Map); 20 ft used as default.
Side setbacks: 10% of parcel width each side (table also allows a 30% aggregate split; not modeled).
Height: 2 stories; 28 ft flat roof, 32 ft pitched roof (varies with parcel size).
Parcel coverage: 45% for new construction (55% for additions to existing homes).
Flat-roof vertical wall height limit of 23 ft, upper-story stepback areas (1% of parcel area each) and outdoor-space limits are NOT modeled geometrically. Check them by hand.
